### Through Promise
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/through-promise
Passage: Galatians 4:23
Points:
- Paul uses Abraham's two sons to illustrate life under the new covenant versus life under the law.
- Abraham turned to Hagar because he struggled to wait on God's supernatural promise.
- The miraculous birth of Isaac shows that justification is solely God's work rather than human striving.
- Like Abraham's reliance on Hagar, the Judaizers attempted to secure righteousness through human effort.
- Believers in Christ are heirs of promise, set free from the bondage of works-righteousness.
